variants.name: 守烬幼龙
variants.desc: Hearth-Ember young dragon: charcoal-gray soft reptile scales, warm ivory belly, dark burnt-wood-looking dorsal spines in the exact source silhouette, modest amber eyes with a protective gentle expression, a tiny tied dark-red cloth neck knot (short flush ends). One main uncanny trait: fine amber ember fissures beneath throat scales and inside mouth, like a safe hearth containing a strange ancient fire. Rounded cheeks, slightly stubborn companion personality. No extra horns, no wings, no jewelry.
